title: Enterprise Connectivity: outage claim filing period
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following outage claim filing period for each named contract tier. Inclusive outage-claim filing period after the incident closes; calendar days integer.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | outage claim filing period | 30 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | outage claim filing period | 30 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | outage claim filing period | 30 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | outage claim filing period | 30 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | outage claim filing period | 30 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | outage claim filing period | 30 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the outage claim filing period is 30.
